system_prompt: You are an expert DevOps engineer. Generate production-quality Infrastructure as Code (IaC) in response to the user's natural-language request. Output ONLY the IaC code (no explanation, no markdown fences) in the language explicitly specified by the user. Apply best practices appropriate to a real production deployment, including security defaults.
original_prompt: Create a GCP Deployment Manager template provisioning a GKE Standard cluster with one node pool for production workloads.
user_message_sent:
Target IaC language: GCP Deployment Manager (YAML config)

Task: Create a GCP Deployment Manager template provisioning a GKE Standard cluster with one node pool for production workloads.

Output only the GCP Deployment Manager (YAML config) code, no commentary or markdown fences.
raw_response:
resources:
- name: vpc-prod
  type: compute.v1.network
  properties:
    autoCreateSubnetworks: false
    routingConfig:
      routingMode: REGIONAL

- name: vpc-prod-subnet-us-central1
  type: compute.v1.subnetwork
  properties:
    region: us-central1
    network: $(ref.vpc-prod.selfLink)
    ipCidrRange: 10.0.0.0/20
    privateIpGoogleAccess: true
    secondaryIpRanges:
    - rangeName: gke-pods
      ipCidrRange: 10.4.0.0/14
    - rangeName: gke-services
      ipCidrRange: 10.8.0.0/20

- name: vpc-prod-router-us-central1
  type: compute.v1.router
  properties:
    region: us-central1
    network: $(ref.vpc-prod.selfLink)

- name: vpc-prod-nat-us-central1
  type: compute.v1.routerNat
  properties:
    region: us-central1
    router: $(ref.vpc-prod-router-us-central1.name)
    natIpAllocateOption: AUTO_ONLY
    sourceSubnetworkIpRangesToNat: LIST_OF_SUBNETWORKS
    subnetworks:
    - name: $(ref.vpc-prod-subnet-us-central1.selfLink)
      sourceIpRangesToNat:
      - ALL_IP_RANGES
    enableEndpointIndependentMapping: true
    minPortsPerVm: 128

- name: gke-secrets-keyring
  type: gcp-types/cloudkms-v1:projects.locations.keyRings
  properties:
    parent: projects/$(project)/locations/us-central1
    keyRingId: gke-secrets-ring

- name: gke-secrets-key
  type: gcp-types/cloudkms-v1:projects.locations.keyRings.cryptoKeys
  properties:
    parent: $(ref.gke-secrets-keyring.name)
    cryptoKeyId: gke-secrets
    purpose: ENCRYPT_DECRYPT
    rotationPeriod: 2592000s
    nextRotationTime: 2026-07-01T00:00:00Z
    versionTemplate:
      algorithm: GOOGLE_SYMMETRIC_ENCRYPTION

- name: kms-iam-binding-gke
  type: gcp-types/cloudkms-v1:virtual.projects.locations.keyRings.cryptoKeys.iamMemberBinding
  properties:
    resource: $(ref.gke-secrets-key.name)
    role: roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyEncrypterDecrypter
    member: serviceAccount:service-$(projectNumber)@container-engine-robot.iam.gserviceaccount.com
  metadata:
    dependsOn:
    - gke-secrets-key

  type: iam.v1.serviceAccount

    accountId: gke-node
    displayName: GKE Node Service Account

- name: project-iam-logging-writer

  properties:
    resource: $(project)
    role: roles/logging.logWriter

  type: gcp-types/cloudresourcemanager-v1:virtual.projects.iamMemberBinding
  properties:
    resource: $(project)
    role: roles/monitoring.metricWriter
    member: serviceAccount:$(ref.gke-node-sa.email)

  type: gcp-types/cloudresourcemanager-v1:virtual.projects.iamMemberBinding
  properties:
    resource: $(project)
    role: roles/stackdriver.resourceMetadata.writer
    member: serviceAccount:$(ref.gke-node-sa.email)

  type: gcp-types/cloudresourcemanager-v1:virtual.projects.iamMemberBinding
  properties:
    resource: $(project)
    role: roles/artifactregistry.reader
    member: serviceAccount:$(ref.gke-node-sa.email)

- name: gke-prod-cluster
  type: gcp-types/container-v1:projects.locations.clusters
  properties:
    parent: projects/$(project)/locations/us-central1
    cluster:
      name: gke-prod
      description: Production GKE Standard regional cluster (private)
      network: $(ref.vpc-prod.selfLink)
      subnetwork: $(ref.vpc-prod-subnet-us-central1.selfLink)
      releaseChannel:
        channel: STABLE
      loggingService: logging.googleapis.com/kubernetes
      monitoringService: monitoring.googleapis.com/kubernetes
      resourceLabels:
        environment: prod
      shieldedNodes:
        enabled: true
      addonsConfig:
        httpLoadBalancing:
          disabled: false
        kubernetesDashboard:
          disabled: true
        networkPolicyConfig:
          disabled: false
      networkPolicy:
        provider: CALICO
        enabled: true
      ipAllocationPolicy:
        useIpAliases: true
        clusterSecondaryRangeName: gke-pods
        servicesSecondaryRangeName: gke-services
      privateClusterConfig:
        enablePrivateNodes: true
        enablePrivateEndpoint: true
        masterIpv4CidrBlock: 172.16.0.16/28
      workloadIdentityConfig:
        identityNamespace: $(project).svc.id.goog
      databaseEncryption:
        state: ENCRYPTED
        keyName: $(ref.gke-secrets-key.name)
      verticalPodAutoscaling:
        enabled: true
      removeDefaultNodePool: true
      initialNodeCount: 1
  metadata:
    dependsOn:
    - vpc-prod

    - vpc-prod-router-us-central1
    - vpc-prod-nat-us-central1

  type: gcp-types/container-v1:projects.locations.clusters.nodePools
  properties:
    parent: projects/$(project)/locations/us-central1/clusters/gke-prod

      config:
        machineType: e2-standard-4
        diskType: pd-balanced

        imageType: COS_CONTAINERD

        - https://www.googleapis.com/auth/cloud-platform

          disable-legacy-endpoints: "true"

          enableIntegrityMonitoring: true
          enableSecureBoot: true
        tags:
        - gke
        - prod
        workloadMetadataConfig:
          nodeMetadata: GKE_METADATA_SERVER
      initialNodeCount: 3
      autoscaling:
        enabled: true
        minNodeCount: 3
        maxNodeCount: 10
      management:
        autoRepair: true
        autoUpgrade: true
      upgradeSettings:
        maxSurge: 1
        maxUnavailable: 0
      locations:
      - us-central1-a
      - us-central1-b
      - us-central1-c
